atomicity.reason: One obligation: an upper bound on the requested current.

comprehensibility.reason: Relies on 'the maximum charging power' and 'nominal pack voltage of the product' defined elsewhere without a reference.

feasibility.reason: Simple arithmetic bound, implementable and not contradicting another stated requirement.

parent_fit.reason: Parent says the session control sets the current limit from the BMS cell limits; the swreq bounds the current by max power / nominal pack voltage and does not engage with the BMS cell limits.
parent_fit.suggestion: Either add the BMS cell limits as a bound or align the parent architecture with the power/voltage derivation.

unambiguity.reason: 'the maximum charging power' admits vehicle-, charger- or BMS-side readings; 'request' (target vs. maximum current limit) is also not fixed.
unambiguity.suggestion: Name the power source and the requested quantity.

variant_consistency.reason: In the bev-only subsystems/chg folder, refines via `<<eu: CCS2, CCS1>>` (named variant, exhaustive eu/na market); product values are referenced generically, not restated in prose.

verifiability.reason: Directionally testable (I_req <= P/U), but which maximum charging power (vehicle REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER, charger offer, BMS) is not stated, so the threshold needs interpretation.
verifiability.suggestion: Reference the vehicle maximum charging power requirement and the product's nominal pack voltage explicitly.

summary: Addresses current limiting but via power/pack-voltage, not the BMS cell limits the parent chooses; 'maximum charging power' is not pinned to a source.
